package main

import (
	"fmt"
 "encoding/json"
 rules "github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/lint/rules/core"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/ast"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/core"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/parser"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/tspath"
	"github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/lint/rule"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf16"
)

func written(text string) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	for _, r := range text {
		if r >= 32 && r <= 126 && r != '\\' {
			b.WriteRune(r)
		} else if r <= 65535 {
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, `\u%04x`, r)
		} else {
			h, l := utf16.EncodeRune(r)
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, `\u%04x\u%04x`, h, l)
		}
	}
	return b.String()
}
func main() {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	countOnly := len(os.Args) > 2
	total, index := 0, 0
	for _, row := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
		if row == "" {
			continue
		}
		columns := strings.Split(row, "\t")
 path := columns[0]
 var options rules.NoUnsafeOptionalChainingOptions
 if len(columns)>1 { if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(columns[1]), &options); err != nil {panic(err)} }
 source, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		file := parser.ParseSourceFile(ast.SourceFileParseOptions{FileName: path, Path: tspath.Path(path)}, string(source), core.ScriptKindTS)
		var findings []rule.Diagnostic
		listener := oracleNoUnsafeOptionalChaining().Run(rule.Context{SourceFile: file, FileCache: rule.NewFileCache(), Report: func(d rule.Diagnostic) { findings = append(findings, d) }}, options)
		var walk func(*ast.Node)
		walk = func(n *ast.Node) {
			if visit := listener[n.Kind]; visit != nil {
				visit(n)
			}
			n.ForEachChild(func(child *ast.Node) bool { walk(child); return false })
		}
		walk(file.AsNode())
		total += len(findings)
		if countOnly {
			continue
		}
		fmt.Printf("case %d\n", index)
		index++
		sort.SliceStable(findings, func(i, j int) bool { return findings[i].Range.Pos() < findings[j].Range.Pos() })
		for _, d := range findings {
			fmt.Printf("finding %d %d %s\t%s\n", d.Range.Pos(), d.Range.End(), d.Message.Id, written(d.Message.Description))
			for _, s := range d.Suggestions {
				fmt.Printf("suggestion %s\t%s\n", s.Message.Id, written(s.Message.Description))
				for _, f := range s.Fixes {
					fmt.Printf("edit %d %d\t%s\n", f.Range.Pos(), f.Range.End(), written(f.Text))
				}
			}
		}
		fmt.Printf("fixed\t%s\n", written(string(source)))
	}
	if countOnly {
		fmt.Println(total)
	}
}
